statement.zh: Wilson OIP 138（2012）正式出版芝加哥大学比斯马亚（阿达卜）1903–1905 发掘此前未充分刊布的田野与器物材料。
statement.en: Wilson OIP 138 (2012) publishes previously under-published field and object materials from the University of Chicago Bismaya (Adab) excavations of 1903–1905.
